how_to_know: Bounded inventory and memory behavior must be measured on an explicit external fixture.
Repeated source text must remain keyed by its complete locator; a source-only match is not safe.
The extracted resource and the rendered component may differ; runtime evidence is required before claiming coverage.
Raw or fixed-slot candidates remain EXTRACT_ONLY/REVIEW_REQUIRED until a symmetric writer is proven.
UTF-8 bytes can be correct while rendered glyphs are missing; record render evidence separately.
Resource-kind detection must use content signatures and fail closed when no symmetric writer exists.
The patch gate and read-back must preserve UTF-8 text, newline style, and locator boundaries for long translations.
